cover.title: Written scenarios and error repair
cover.overview: Solve three scenarios in writing (broken map, wrong desk, failed transform), then repair the broken map copy.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled window if the app cannot open.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Next you will learn Three first moves, then do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.
You just named today's job. Now the idea: Three first moves. Then you will do the lab.

blocks.heading: Three first moves
blocks.body:
A. Completeness names a missing link. Open the map. Fix the href (or drop the row). Run completeness again.

B. A project manager wants the landing page as a DITA map. Say no. The landing page is Sites. The handbook is DITA.

C. A PDF transform failed. Open the transformation log. Quote the first real error. Do not reinstall Oxygen. Do not Quick Publish the map.

Then repair the broken map copy. Completeness clean when you stop.
